q: Which authority has full powers to sanction railway expenditure within budget provision?
No proposal involving expenditure can be sanctioned without which essential requirement?
The first canon of financial propriety requires an officer to exercise what standard of care?

options.C: The same vigilance as a prudent person with his own money

q: Splitting a sanction into parts to keep it within one's own powers is what?
Sanction of expenditure essentially means what?

options.A: Allotment of funds under a grant
options.B: Approval or authority to incur the expenditure

q: Appropriation in railway finance refers to what?

options.A: Allotment of funds under a grant or head

q: Expenditure on a new service requires the sanction of whom?
Re-appropriation of funds between units within a grant requires whose sanction?

options.C: General Manager with concurrence of FA&CAO

q: Which of the following can never be met through re-appropriation?

options.A: Transfer between sub-heads of the same grant

q: One canon of propriety bars an authority from sanctioning expenditure which does what?

options.D: Is directly or indirectly to its own advantage

q: The Schedule of Powers on Railways is issued by whom?
When expenditure is likely to exceed the sanctioned estimate, what should the officer do?

options.C: Prepare a revised estimate and obtain fresh sanction

q: The main object of expenditure control is to do what?

options.B: Keep expenditure within sanction, budget and propriety

q: Financial concurrence on an expenditure proposal is given by whom?
Powers delegated to a subordinate authority cannot do what?

options.A: Exceed the powers of the delegating authority

q: Expenditure should not be prima facie more than the occasion demands is a what?
No expenditure can ordinarily be incurred without what?
Control of expenditure by the Accounts Department is exercised through what?

options.B: Verification of sanctions and monthly expenditure review

q: A revised estimate becomes necessary when what happens?

options.C: Anticipated cost differs materially from the sanction

q: Whose concurrence is essential before a GM sanctions a major expenditure proposal?
Splitting of sanctions is prohibited because it does what?
The liability register maintained by Accounts serves what purpose?
Expenditure from public money for a particular person is allowed only when what?

options.A: A legal claim exists or it follows recognized policy or custom

q: Which document authorises incurring expenditure on a railway work?
Excess expenditure over a sanctioned estimate without fresh sanction is what?
The Accounts office warns departments when expenditure does what?

options.A: Is likely to exceed the budget provision

q: Delegation of financial powers on Railways flows in which direction?

options.B: From higher to lower authority within SOP limits

q: Expenditure on a new instrument of service cannot be met by what?
Financial propriety demands economy in expenditure. What does this mean?

options.A: Spending no more than necessary for the purpose

q: Sanction and appropriation differ in what way?

options.D: Sanction approves spending; appropriation allots the funds

q: Who exercises financial concurrence at the zonal railway level?
A completion report for a work is required for what purpose?

options.B: Accounting for actual expenditure against the sanction

q: Powers of sanction must be exercised in what manner?

options.D: Within the limits laid down in the Schedule of Powers

q: Which of the following is a canon of financial propriety?

options.A: No authority should sanction expenditure to its own advantage

q: The monthly review of expenditure against budget is carried out by whom?
Re-appropriation is generally not allowed in which case?

options.B: From one grant to another grant

q: Before sanctioning expenditure, the competent authority must ensure what?

options.A: Funds are available and Finance has concurred

q: An excess over a sanctioned estimate arises when what happens?

options.D: Actual or anticipated cost exceeds the sanctioned amount

q: What is the purpose of maintaining a register of sanctions?

options.C: To watch that expenditure stays within sanctions

q: Financial concurrence can be dispensed with in which situation?
Delegated powers must be exercised subject to what?

options.D: The conditions and limits in the SOP or delegation order

q: Which statement about sanction is correct?

options.A: Sanction alone does not provide funds

q: The object of expenditure control includes what?
If a sanctioned work's scope increases materially, what is the correct step?

options.C: Obtain revised sanction for the increased scope

q: The FA&CAO's concurrence on a proposal ensures what?

options.A: Financial scrutiny, prudence and availability of funds

q: Charged expenditure on Railways is characterised by what?

options.B: It is voted like other expenditure
options.C: It can be created by a GM
options.D: It is not subject to Parliament's vote, though provision is needed

q: Which register helps watch the progress of expenditure against estimates for works?
A sanction issued by an authority beyond its delegated powers is what?

options.A: Valid if the work is urgent

q: The canons of financial propriety apply to whom?

options.A: Every officer incurring or sanctioning public expenditure

q: Effective expenditure control ultimately aims at what?

options.D: Economy, efficiency and accountability in public spending
